label: Editorial Collage
summary: Layered culture and evidence scenes using modular crops, source captions, and deliberate placeholders.
description: A portrait-first editorial collage grammar with layered media crops, source-role captions, recap rails, and deterministic crop handling for embed-only assets.
layoutGrammar: Render only assets classified as embed_asset; all other classifications produce a deliberate placeholder.
Use typed crop focus and zoom values for every media slot and clamp them deterministically at render time.
Attach captions directly to crops so source role, evidence value, and provenance remain visible.
Keep recap and callout rails outside the highest-overlap media zone for readable composition.
Use original local fixtures only; do not include proprietary imagery, logos, screenshots, or brand identities.

sourcePolicy.notes: Review assets are local original SVG fixtures. Quote-collage cases intentionally exercise rejected context_only material and missing embeddable media.

notes: The dedicated family composition avoids shared registry edits.
The quote-collage fixture validates placeholder behavior for missing and rejected assets.
